title: Replacement Base Days — Refill-Date Convention for Lost or Stolen Supplies
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, lost or stolen supplies.** The replacement days of a lost or stolen supply start from the replacement base days.

**Drug and refill.** The drug is the one named on the latest counter rejection for refill too soon on the coverage, and its supply is measured from the latest paid refill of that drug.

**Convention.** The replacement base days are, for a controlled substance, the days from today to the ordinary controlled refill date, which is the whole number of days in the plan's controlled refill percent of the latest refill's days supply less the calendar days since it was filled; for a drug that is not controlled and has two or more paid refills in the last three months, the same count at the plan's ordinary refill percent; and otherwise the days still on hand, never fewer than one day.

A controlled substance is a drug whose latest refill carries a DEA schedule (CII to CV). The whole number of days drops any fraction. The refill percents are the member's PrairieRx plan's refill thresholds for controlled substances and for other drugs. The days still on hand are the refill's days supply less the calendar days since it was filled.

### Method table

| Drug | Paid refills of the drug, last three months | Replacement base days |
|---|---|---|
| Controlled substance | any | Whole days of the controlled refill percent of the latest refill's days supply, less the days since it was filled |
| Not controlled | Two or more | Whole days of the ordinary refill percent of the latest refill's days supply, less the days since it was filled |
| Not controlled | One or none | The days still on hand, never fewer than one day |

### Worked figures (hypothetical percents: 90 for controlled, 75 for others; a 30-day refill filled 10 days ago)

| Drug | Paid refills, last three months | Replacement base days |
|---|---|---|
| Controlled | 1 | 27 less 10, that is 17 |
| Not controlled | 3 | 22 (75 percent of 30, fractions dropped) less 10, that is 12 |
| Not controlled | 1 | 30 less 10, that is 20 |
